sentences.text: Fiona Grant is the social worker.
Fiona Grant previously visited Edna Holloway in the summer.
Joy Mensah is the senior care worker.
Joy Mensah walks with Edna Holloway to the dining room.
Edna Holloway can walk with assistance from Joy or one of the girls.
Edna Holloway reports that the food is 'alright' but 'bit bland'.
Edna Holloway likes the lounge because she can see the garden.
Edna Holloway's hearing aids are not working properly; the left one whistles.
An audiology appointment is scheduled for the 8th of December.
Edna Holloway's daughter, Pauline, calls her every Sunday.
Pauline lives in Inverness and cannot travel down to visit Edna.
Room 4 is coming free next week.
Edna Holloway does not want to cause trouble for anyone.
Edna Holloway wants to feel safe in her room and wants Arthur Pike kept away from her end of the corridor.
Edna Holloway would like a room nearer the lounge.
On the night of Saturday the 14th of November, Joy Mensah was on night shift and conducted a 2.30 check.
Arthur Pike is a resident in room 12, down the same corridor.
On the night of the 14th of November, Arthur Pike was found in Edna Holloway's bed under the covers, next to her.
Edna Holloway was awake and upset, saying 'get off' when Joy Mensah entered the room.
Joy Mensah got Arthur Pike up and walked him back to his room.
Joy Mensah sat with Edna Holloway and wrote the incident in the incident book.
Edna Holloway woke up and saw a man in her bed.
Edna Holloway said the man touched her on her bottom and front, under her nightie.
Edna Holloway told the man to stop and repeated 'stop it, get out' multiple times.
Arthur Pike did not enter Edna Holloway's room before the 14th of November.
There is no record of Arthur Pike entering Edna Holloway's room prior to the 14th of November.
Joy Mensah reported the incident to Mrs Dobson, the manager, on the Monday morning after the incident.
Mrs Dobson said Arthur Pike is confused and went into the wrong room.
The incident was not reported to anyone outside the home.
Edna Holloway sold her bungalow.
